Flood & Coastal Risk

Which locations may be exposed under a defined flood or coastal scenario?

Start for Free ↗Talk to Sales ↗

Screen locations against a defined flood or coastal scenario

Example

Flood and coastal screening should make the scenario visible: what hazard or water-level condition is represented, what geography and period it applies to, how it is combined with assets or locations, and what the resulting exposure layer means. GriidAi should support review of these assumptions before the output is interpreted.

Scenario layer, terrain/elevation where relevant, asset/location overlays, exposure map/table.
